blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.
blocks.zh: LeJEPA中的SIGREG术语将特征规范化,以具有异热带的高斯分布. 我们的第一个结果是表明,这个常态化者实际上无法实现其目标。 我们设计了一个经过修改的规范器来更好地执行目标. 这导致业绩略有改善。 例如,在ImageNet-100上,我们经过修改的正则器以1.3美元\times$更少的时代达到SIGREG的最终精度. 我们的第二个结果认为,自我监督的编码器不应该具有异色高斯的特征. 我们显示,LeJEPA中的校正术语与SIGREG冲突,因为它将特征的大小与其方向相配. 与此相反,异热带高斯的特征将带来独立的规模和方向。 与LeJEPA合作获得的特征事实上不是异热带的. 因此,LeJEPA有两个问题. 其常态器弱,异形高斯靶太严格. 我们的第三个结果是重塑异热带高斯常态器,只执行大小和方向的边际分布,而不执行独立性. 这导致一个简单的规范化术语PolarReg,可以可靠地在很多不同的数据集,批量大小和嵌入维度上进行优化,而没有任何超参数变化. 在ImageNet-1k上,我们的技术与LeJEPA及其变体的精度相匹配,以4.7美元\times$更少的时代. 它使最终准确度提高了1.8分.

blocks.en:
Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA) [ 27 ] are trained to predict the embedding of one view, such as a randomly cropped image, from the embedding of another view of the same image.
Feature collapse, i.e., features that can be predicted reliably across different views but are not sufficiently informative of the downstream task, is a major issue while instantiating this idea. Popular methods like DINO [ 11 ] , iBOT [ 47 ] , and I-JEPA [ 3 ] use heuristics to work around this issue.
More recently, LeJEPA [ 5 ] and its variants like VISReg [ 45 ] argue that they are effective at preventing feature collapse, without these heuristics, because of a specific regularization term.

地貌崩塌,即不同观点之间可以可靠地预测的地貌,但对下游任务信息不足的地貌,是一重大问题,同时即刻提出这个想法. 例如DINO [11], iBOT [47], I-JEPA [3] 等流行方法,

blocks.en:
The authors of LeJEPA argue [ 5 , Theorem 1] that embeddings should be distributed as an isotropic Gaussian because the downstream task is not known a priori. Indeed, if the embeddings are anisotropic, their projections onto different unit vectors have different variances and a linear probe for the task can be more biased.
However, this claim holds only in the worst case over all downstream tasks. Natural tasks have structure and can benefit from anisotropic embeddings [ 34 ] . Our second result is to show that SIGReg conflicts with the alignment term in LeJEPA. An isotropic Gaussian embedding distribution makes the magnitudes and directions of the embeddings independent of each other. We show that the alignment term instead introduces dependence between the two. In fact, the minimizer of the alignment term assigns smaller magnitudes to more ambiguous images (see Figs. 1 and 2.3 ). We therefore argue that, in LeJEPA-like objectives, the magnitudes of the embeddings should depend on their directions. We show that this enables the encoder to train faster and more accurately. We prove that such embeddings do not collapse ( B.4 ).
blocks.zh:
LeJEPA的作者认为"[5,定理1]"嵌入物应该作为异地高斯人来分配,因为下游的任务不是先验的. 的确,如果嵌入物是异同性的,它们向不同单位向量的预测会有不同的差异,对任务的线性探测可能更偏颇.
然而,这一主张只在最坏的情况下适用于所有下游任务。 自然任务具有结构,可以从异同位素嵌入中得益 [34]. 我们的第二个结果是显示SIGREG与LeJEPA中的对齐词相冲突. 异地高斯嵌入分布使嵌入体的大小和方向相互独立. 我们表明,对接一词反而引入了两者之间的依赖。 事实上,对齐名词的最小化器为更模糊的图像分配了更小的分量(见图1和2.3. 因此,我们主张,在类似《正义与环保法》的目标中,嵌入体的规模应取决于其方向。 我们显示,这使得编码器可以更快更准确地训练. 我们证明这种嵌入不会崩溃(B.4.).

blocks.en:
Since the two terms in LeJEPA work against each other, the accuracy of the approach depends heavily on the regularization weight λ \lambda .
On ImageNet-100, the classification accuracy of the original LeJEPA encoders varies by up to 7.7% points for different values of λ \lambda . The best λ \lambda depends on the number of views v {v} , the number of slices k {k} and how the integral is approximated [ 5 , Table 7] .
On ImageNet-1k, the accuracy varies by up to 3.8% points depending upon these settings [ 5 , Table 1] .
LeJEPA uses hyper-parameter search to choose these settings. A new dataset, architecture, number of views or embedding dimension may need a new search.
blocks.zh:
由于LeJEPA的两个术语是相互对立的,因此方法的准确性在很大程度上取决于规范化的权重。
在ImageNet-100上,最初的LeJEPA编码器的分类精度,对于QQ\lambda的不同值,其分数相差可达7.7%. 最佳的\\ lambda 取决于视图数 v {v}, 切片数 k {k} 以及构件如何大致 [5, 表 7] 。
在ImageNet-1k上,准确度因这些设置而相差可达3.8% [5,表1].
LeJEPA使用超参数搜索来选择这些设置. 新的数据集、架构、视图数量或嵌入维度可能需要新的搜索。

blocks.en:
Our third result is to develop a new regularizer, called PolarReg, that replaces SIGReg. This regularizer matches the marginal distributions of the embedding magnitudes, and the pairwise inner products between embedding directions, to those of an isotropic Gaussian, computed analytically.
PolarReg is very simple; it is designed with optimization techniques to ensure that its hyper-parameters need no tuning for different batch sizes, embedding dimensions or magnitudes ( Sec. 2.4 ). All experiments in this paper use a single hyper-parameter setting for PolarReg. On ImageNet-1k, PolarReg matches the accuracy of VISReg in 4.7 × \times fewer epochs, and reaches a final accuracy 1.8% better than VISReg ( Figs. 1 and 3.1 ). It uses the same training hyper-parameters as VISReg, with no additional search.
Finally, we show that the magnitude of embeddings obtained with our approach, serves as a confidence score and reliably detects out-of-domain images without any labels ( Sec. 3.3 ).
Related work is discussed in Sec. A .
blocks.zh:
我们的第三个结果是开发出一种新的正则剂,叫做"极地正则"(PolarReg)来取代SIGREG. 这种正则器将嵌入量的边缘分布和嵌入取向之间的对等内产物与异地高斯相匹配,通过分析计算得出。
PolarReg非常简单;它采用优化技术设计,以确保它的超参数不需要调试不同批量大小,嵌入尺寸或等分(第2.4节). 本文中的所有实验都使用一个用于PolarReg的单一超参数设置. 在ImageNet-1k上,PolarReg在4.7×\times中与VISReg的精度相匹配,比VISReg(图1和3.1)更能达到1.8%的最终精度. 它使用与VISReg相同的训练超参数,没有额外的搜索.
最后,我们表明,通过我们的方法获得的嵌入量是一个信任分数,并可靠地检测出没有标签的域外图像(第3.3条)。
相关工作在Sec.A.讨论。

blocks.en:
Proposition B.1 explains this observation.
We consider embeddings sampled from N ​ ( 0 , Σ ) \text{N}(0,\Sigma) where Σ ∈ ℝ d × d \Sigma\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d} has r r nonzero eigenvalues, all equal to d / r d/r .
We show that the expected SIGReg on such embeddings exceeds its expectation on control batches by a term that grows with the batch size b {b} .
For intuition, consider projections of the b {b} embeddings along a particular slice.
The variance of projections along a slice a a is a ⊤ ​ Σ ​ a a^{\top}\Sigma a . We show that the variance of this quantity across random slices a a equals 2 ​ ( d − r ) / ( r ​ ( d + 2 ) ) 2(d-r)/(r(d+2)) . The empirical variance of b {b} samples of N ​ ( 0 , 1 ) \text{N}(0,1) has variance about 2 / b 2/{b} .
Therefore, SIGReg can identify non-isotropic embeddings if 2 ​ ( d − r ) / ( r ​ ( d + 2 ) ) 2(d-r)/(r(d+2)) and 2 / b 2/{b} are significantly different from each other. These quantities do not depend on the number of slices k {k} , which explains why the discriminative ability of SIGReg does not improve with a larger k {k} . This also shows why the two quantities can differ a lot for large batch sizes b {b} .
For a fixed ratio r / d r/d , the first variance falls as 1 / d 1/d .

blocks.en: The magnitude and direction of embeddings with an isotropic Gaussian distribution are independent of each other. In this section, we calculate analytical expressions for the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction of such embeddings. This will enable us to enforce the isotropic Gaussian regularization more precisely.
blocks.zh: 以异地高斯分布的嵌入体的大小和方向是独立的. 在本节中,我们计算出这种嵌入体的大小和方向的边际分布的分析表达式. 这将使我们能够更准确地实施同地高斯的正规化。

A nonzero random vector u ∼ N ​ ( 0 , I d × d ) u\sim\text{N}(0,I_{d\times d}) if and only if (i) ρ \rho is distributed according to the χ d \chi_{d} distribution, (ii) u ^ \hat{u} is uniform on the ( d − 1 ) (d-1) -dimensional sphere S d − 1 S^{d-1} , and (iii) ρ \rho and u ^ \hat{u} are independent.

Section B.2 provides the proof. Theorem 1 shows that, for embeddings u u to be samples of an isotropic Gaussian, the marginal distribution of the magnitude must be χ d \chi_{d} , while their directions should be distributed uniformly on the ( d − 1 ) (d-1) -dimensional sphere.

The view disagreement D i D_{i} varies with the embedding direction. It is large for ambiguous images that typically lie in between two semantically distinct classes, and it is small for embeddings that lie near their class centroid.
Since swapping the magnitudes of two images does not alter the distribution of the magnitudes, the alignment term is minimized only when images with larger view disagreement get smaller magnitude embeddings. This, in effect, makes the magnitude and direction dependent on each other.
Conceptually, this dependence encodes the structure in the data learned during self-supervised learning. Enforcing the embeddings to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution prevents this structure from crystallizing during training.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 a,b show that in encoders trained with SIGReg and PolarReg, the magnitude of an embedding falls as its angle to the mean embedding of its class grows. Additionally, images with larger view disagreement lie at larger angles, and at a given angle, they have smaller magnitudes. Figure B.2 shows that images with larger view disagreement consequently get less weight in the alignment term. Figure 3 c and d measure these trends over whole datasets. In (c), averaged over classes, the magnitude falls as the angle to the class mean grows, for both SIGReg and PolarReg-naive on three datasets. In (d), on Tiny-ImageNet-200, it falls as the view disagreement grows.
Just like Fig. 1 , these results further corroborate our findings in Sec. 2.1 . SIGReg embeddings are anisotropic, their magnitudes depend strongly on the directions. Section B.4 discusses Proposition B.2 and verifies its assumption on trained encoders.

To elaborate, if the embedding magnitudes are distributed as χ d \chi_{d} and directions are uniform on the sphere, we show that every eigenvalue of the second-moment matrix of the embeddings is within 2 / d 2/\sqrt{d} of 1, i.e., the embeddings do not collapse, whatever the dependence between magnitude and direction.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验结果

blocks.en:
In this section, we discuss results obtained using PolarReg on a number of benchmark datasets.
Additionally, we show that PolarReg can be easily used for multi-modal learning and that the embedding magnitude can be used as a confidence score and to reliably detect out-of-domain images.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们讨论在一些基准数据集上使用PolarReg获得的结果。
此外,我们表明,PolarReg可以很容易地用于多模式学习,并可以将嵌入量用作置信分并可靠地检测出域外图像.

blocks.en: 3.1 PolarReg learns better features than sliced objectives in 4.7 × \times fewer epochs
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 PolarReg 在 4.7 ×\times 中学习比切入目标更好的特性

blocks.en:
Table 1 showed that on ImageNet-100, PolarReg-naive obtains a higher accuracy than SIGReg (81.00% against 78.92%) and that it reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.5 × \times fewer epochs.
In the same setting, PolarReg (not in table) reaches a final accuracy of 82.42% and matches the final accuracy of SIGReg with 1.8 × \times fewer epochs.
blocks.zh:
表1显示,在ImageNet-100上,PolarReg-naive获得的精度高于SIGreg(81.00%对78.92%),并在1.5×xxxxxxxxxx更短的时段达到SIGreg的最终精度.
在同一环境下,PolarReg(不在表格中)达到82.42%的最终精度,并匹配了SIGREG的最终精度,比起1.8×\时间更少.

blocks.en:
On larger datasets like ImageNet-1k, PolarReg reaches the linear probing accuracy of sliced objectives with about 4.7 × \times fewer epochs (see Tab. 2 ).
We train ViT-B and L architectures with the same training hyper-parameters as VISReg; Sec. C.4 provides training and evaluation details.
A ViT-B encoder trained with PolarReg for 100 epochs performs about the same as VISReg trained for 400 epochs. It exceeds LeJEPA trained for 100 epochs by 3.4%.
A ViT-L encoder trained with PolarReg for 100 epochs exceeds VISReg trained for 400 epochs, and is 1.6% above both VISReg and LeJEPA trained for 100 epochs.
When trained for 400 epochs it is 1.8% above VISReg trained for 400 epochs.
PolarReg shows consistent scaling behavior across model sizes (ViT-B to L) and training length (100 to 400 epochs).
blocks.zh:

PolarReg显示在模型大小(ViT-B到L)和训练长度(100到400个纪元)之间一致的缩放行为.

blocks.en:
Features of PolarReg encoders on ImageNet-1k transfer quite well to other datasets in Tab. 2 .
In particular, the ViT-B encoder trained with PolarReg for 400 epochs transfers much better than the VISReg or LeJEPA encoders. It is on par with modern SSL methods on ImageNet to CIFAR transfer evaluation. Figure 4 qualitatively analyzes PolarReg features. It shows that they are semantically consistent, and illustrates that the embedding magnitude is smaller for semantically ambiguous images.
blocks.zh:
ImageNet-1k上的PolarReg编码器的特性将相当好的传输到Tab中的其他数据集. 2 (中文(简体) ).
特别是,用极地Reg为400个纪元培训的VIT-B编码器传输比VISReg或LeJEPA编码器要好得多. 它与ImageNet上的现代SSL方法与CIFAR传输评价相同. 图4对极地区域特征进行了定性分析。 这表明它们具有相容性,并表明嵌入量对于相容性模糊的图像来说较小.

blocks.en:
Features of PolarReg encoders on ImageNet-1k transfer to six datasets from other domains, such as galaxies, chest X-rays and abdominal CT, and to tasks like semantic segmentation of ADE20K ( Tab. D.4 ).
For these tasks, PolarReg performs similar to most other SSL methods, including the sliced objectives.
Compared to other methods, PolarReg is also better at pretraining small models on small datasets.
A ViT-S/8 encoder pretrained using PolarReg on Galaxy10, with about 16,000 training images, outperforms all other methods in Tab. D.5 at the end of training, and matches other methods with 2 × \times fewer epochs.

对于这些任务,PolalyReg执行类似于大多数其它SSL方法,包括切出的目标.
与其他方法相比, PolarReg还更擅长在小数据集上预先训练出小模型.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Peak GPU memory usage of the regularizers in a forward and backward pass.
blocks.zh: 图5:前向和后向通道中常态器的峰值GPU内存使用.

blocks.en:
On a single RTX 4090, computing PolarReg takes ∼ \sim 0.52 ms for batch sizes ranging from 224 to 1024. It is 4–18 × \times faster than VISReg and 35–164 × \times faster than SIGReg, both computed with 4096 slices. See Sec. D.6 for details.
The computation time of PolarReg is bound by GPU kernel launch overhead, whereas sliced objectives are memory-bound with latency that scales with b {b} .
As shown in Fig. 5 , PolarReg forward and backward passes need much less GPU memory, about 0.14 GB at b = 2048 {b}=2048 against 2.4 GB for VISReg and 34 GB for SIGReg.
blocks.zh:
在单个RTX 4090上,计算极地Reg的批量尺寸从224到1024取取出 \ sim 0.52 ms. 它的速度比VISReg快4–18 ×;比SIGREG快35–164 ×;两者都是用4096个切片来计算的. 详情见D.6. 法官。
PolarReg的计算时间由GPU内核发射高空所约束,而切片的目标则由内存所约束,并具有以 b {b} 为尺度的耐久性.
如图5所显示,极地Reg前后行需要的GPU内存要少得多,约0.14 GB at b = 2048 {b}=2048 相對 2.4 GB 对于VISReg 和 34 GB 对于 SIGreg.

blocks.en: 3.2 PolarReg generalizes to other modalities, and classifiers trained on one modality can transfer to others
blocks.zh: 3.2 将PolarReg归纳为其他模式,接受过一种模式培训的分类人员可以转移到其他模式

blocks.en:
PolarReg can be readily used for other modalities, such as depth images, with the same objective and hyper-parameters.
We train one ViT-S/8 encoder per modality on RGB and depth images of TartanAir v2 [ 33 ] , using only daytime data, and test on both daytime and nighttime data.
A linear classifier on frozen features is used to predict the scene (out of 18 scenes) given the RGB or depth image.
See Sec. D.4 for details. Figure 1(b) shows that the PolarReg depth encoder achieves a classification accuracy of 79.3% on daytime data as opposed to 95.9% for the RGB data.
At night, the RGB classifier falls to 30.3%, while the depth classifier is only mildly affected, with an accuracy of 71.6%.
blocks.zh:
PolarReg可以方便地用于其他模式,如深度图像,具有相同的目标和超参数.
我们只使用日间数据,在RGB和TartanAir v2 [33]的深度图像上每模式训练一个Vit-S/8编码器,并测试日间和夜间数据。
使用被冻结特征上的线性分解器来预测场景(出自18幕),给出了RGB或深度图像.
详情见D.4. 法官。 图1 (b)显示,极地Reg深度编码器在日间数据上实现了79.3%的分类精度,而RGB数据则为95.9%.
夜间,RGB分级器降为30.3%,而深度分级器仅受轻度影响,精度为71.6%.

blocks.en:
In Fig. 1(b) , the two encoders are trained separately, so their features are not aligned. As expected, classifiers trained on RGB encoders perform poorly on depth features.
An orthogonal map, fitted on just 8192 unlabeled pairs of daytime RGB and depth samples, can be used to align the features.
After doing so, the RGB classifier is almost as accurate on depth encoder features as the depth classifier (75.1% against 79.3% at day, 68.5% against 71.6% at night), without using any depth labels.
This shows that separately trained encoders can be aligned with just a few unlabeled pairs. Using PolarReg, one can transfer a classifier trained on one modality to another without ground truth labels.
blocks.zh:
在图1 (b)中,两个编码器被分别训练,因此其特性没有对齐. 如所料,接受过RGB编码器培训的分类器在深度特性上表现不佳.
仅安装在8192对无标签的日间RGB和深度样品上的正向图可用于对齐特征.
之后,RGB的分类器在深度编码器特征上几乎与深度分类器一样准确(日间75.1%对79.3%,夜间68.5%对71.6%),没有使用深度标签.
这表明,经过单独训练的编码器只能与少数没有被标记的对子对齐. 使用PolarReg,人们可以将一个在一个模式上受过训练的分级器转移到另一个没有地面真伪标签的分级器.

blocks.en: 3.3 The embedding magnitude detects out-of-domain images and acts as a confidence score for classification
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 嵌入星等探测出域外图像,并起到分类信任分的作用

blocks.en:
In Fig. 4 c, the ferrets look less ambiguous and have lower view disagreement with rising embedding magnitude.
This is demonstrated in Fig. 3 and explained further in Proposition B.2 , suggesting that the embedding magnitude can be a label-free measure of the semantic ambiguity of an image.
blocks.zh:
在图4c中,雪貂看起来不太模糊,对不断上升的嵌入量持更低的见解.
图3说明了这一点,提案B.2进一步解释了这一点,认为嵌入量可以是图像语义模糊性的无标签度量.

blocks.en:
Since images with higher view disagreement get smaller magnitudes, most images unlike the training data should fall in the lower tail of χ d \chi_{d} .
We test this on a ViT-B trained with PolarReg on ImageNet-1k by thresholding the magnitude. We report the AUROC of the fraction of test images it rejects against the fraction of ImageNet-1k validation images it rejects. See Sec. D.1 for details. Table D.1 shows that this detects heavy corruptions (AUROC 0.99 for 8 × 8 8\times 8 block averaging) and out-of-domain images such as galaxies, chest X-rays and retina scans (0.80–0.95).
It misses mild blur and contrast changes, to which augmentations make the encoder invariant. This test needs no calibration data. The threshold that rejects a given fraction of in-domain images should be a quantile of χ d \chi_{d} , known before training.
blocks.zh:
由于观点有较高分歧的图像得到更小的分量,大多数图像与训练数据不同的是会倒入QQ d\chi_{d}的下尾.
我们用一个在图像网1克上用PolarReg训练的ViT-B测试这个, 通过阈值。 我们向AUROC报告它拒绝的测试图像的一分部分,而不是它拒绝的ImageNet-1k验证图像的一分部分。 详情见D.1节。 表D.1显示,这检测出严重腐败(AUROC 0.99,8×8 8\times 8个区块平均值)以及星系、胸部X光和视网膜扫描等域外图像(0.80-0.95)。
它忽略了轻微的模糊和对比的变化,其中的增强使得编码器变异. 此测试不需要校正数据 。 拒绝一定比例的域内图像的阈值应该是训练前已知的 \\ d\ \ \\ d 的等分数 。

blocks.en:
Images whose augmented views disagree more are often ambiguous, for instance when an object is small, occluded or placed among other objects.
We expect images with larger embedding magnitudes to be classified more accurately.
We sort the ImageNet-1k validation images by their embedding magnitudes and measure accuracy on different fractions of images with the largest magnitudes. As Fig. 4 d shows, keeping fewer images, from all of them to the 10% with the largest magnitude, accuracy of the probe rises monotonically from 76.7% to 91.8%. Hence, the probe is more accurate on images with larger embedding magnitudes.
blocks.zh:
增加观点分歧较大的图像往往模棱两可,例如当物体很小、被占有或放置在其他物体中时。
我们期望更准确地对嵌入量较大的图像进行分类。
我们通过嵌入等分大小的图像来排序ImageNet-1k验证等分大小的图像,并测量不同分大小的图像的准确性. 如来相. 4d显示,保存较少的图像,从所有图像到尺寸最大的10%,探测器的精度单调从76.7%上升到91.8%. 因此,探测器在嵌入量较大的图像上更准确.

blocks.en: Appendix A Related work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en:
Several variants of LeJEPA [ 5 ] change its regularizer or its target.
VISReg [ 45 ] matches the sliced projections of SIGReg with a Wasserstein distance.
KerJEPA [ 48 ] replaces the sliced projections with a kernel discrepancy between the embeddings and the target.
SPHERE-JEPA [ 31 ] normalizes the embeddings and changes the target of SIGReg to the uniform distribution on the sphere.
UR-JEPA [ 26 ] changes the target to distributions that concentrate near a low-dimensional subset of the embedding space.
Others change the target when domain-specific geometric priors are available [ 38 ] or to handle multiple modalities [ 4 ] .
We enforce the marginal distributions of an isotropic Gaussian for the magnitude and the direction of the embeddings, without requiring the two to be independent.
Our angular penalty is related to losses that make the embedding directions uniform on a sphere [ 42 , 8 , 15 , 29 ] .
A regularizer must also prevent dimensional collapse, where the embeddings end up only in a lower-dimensional subspace [ 25 , 23 , 28 ] . Such collapse is often measured by the rank or the spectrum of the embeddings [ 17 , 1 , 39 ] . Many methods prevent it by constraining the covariance of the embeddings [ 6 , 46 , 14 , 44 ] . PolarReg prevents it by constraining the distributions of the magnitudes and of the pairwise inner products ( B.4 ).
blocks.zh:
LeJEPA的几种变体会改变它的常态器或目标.
VISREG [45] 与SIGREG的切片预测相匹配,与Wasserstein相距相去甚远.
KerJEPA [48] 用嵌入子和目标之间的内核相差来取代被切片的预测.
SPHERE-JEPA [31] 将嵌入式规范化,将SIGREG的目标改为球体上的统一分布.
UR-JEPA [26] 将目标更改为在嵌入空间的低维子集附近集中的分布.
另一些则在有特定域几何前缀[38]或处理多模式[4]时改变目标.
我们执行异地高斯人对嵌入体的大小和取向的边缘分布,而不要求两者独立.
我们的角罚与使嵌入方向统一在一个球体上的损失有关[42、8、15、29]。
常态化器还必须防止维相倒塌,即嵌入到一个下维分相空间[25,23,28]. 这种倒塌往往以嵌入物的分级或频谱来测量[17, 1, 39]. 许多方法通过限制嵌入物的共性来阻止它[6,46,14,44]. PolarReg通过限制量和对等内产物的分布来阻止它(B.4.

blocks.en: Theorem 1 shows that a simple polar decomposition of the isotropic Gaussian is possible and exact. Here, we provide a short proof.

blocks.en:
Let u u be a nonzero random vector in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} , and write u = ρ ​ u ^ u=\rho\,\hat{u} with magnitude ρ = ‖ u ‖ \rho=\left\|u\right\| and direction u ^ = u / ‖ u ‖ \hat{u}=u/\left\|u\right\| on the unit sphere S d − 1 S^{d-1} .
Then u ∼ N ​ ( 0 , I d × d ) u\sim\text{N}(0,I_{d\times d}) if and only if ρ ∼ χ d \rho\sim\chi_{d} , u ^ ∼ Unif ⁡ ( S d − 1 ) \hat{u}\sim\mathrm{Unif}(S^{d-1}) , and ρ \rho and u ^ \hat{u} are independent.

This is a quite standard result on spherical distributions [ 30 , Section 1.5] . We give a short proof.
Suppose that u ∼ N ​ ( 0 , I d × d ) u\sim\text{N}(0,I_{d\times d}) .
Its d d coordinates are independent samples of N ​ ( 0 , 1 ) \text{N}(0,1) , so ρ 2 = ‖ u ‖ 2 \rho^{2}=\left\|u\right\|^{2} , the sum of their squares, follows a chi-squared distribution with d d degrees of freedom, denoted by χ d 2 \chi_{d}^{2} .
For every orthogonal d × d d\times d matrix H H , H ​ u ∼ N ​ ( 0 , I d × d ) Hu\sim\text{N}(0,I_{d\times d}) , so H ​ u Hu has the same distribution as u u .
If a nonzero random vector has this property, its direction is uniform on S d − 1 S^{d-1} and independent of its magnitude [ 30 , Theorem 1.5.6] .
This directly shows u ^ ∼ Unif ⁡ ( S d − 1 ) \hat{u}\sim\mathrm{Unif}(S^{d-1}) , and ρ \rho and u ^ \hat{u} to be independent.

blocks.en: B.4 Properties of coupling embedding magnitude and direction by the alignment term
blocks.zh: B.4 组合嵌入量和方向的属性

blocks.en:
Proposition B.2 shows that the alignment term is minimized only when images with larger view disagreement get smaller magnitude embeddings.
The view disagreement varies with the embedding direction, for instance with its cosine similarity to the class center, and hence so does the magnitude.
The independence of magnitude and direction in an isotropic Gaussian forbids this dependence, and works against the alignment term.
We also verify that the assumption of the proposition, that all views of an image have the same magnitude, holds closely on trained encoders.
Replacing the magnitudes of the views by their mean changes the alignment term of most images by less than 5%.
In B.4 , we prove that forgoing the independence term cannot result in collapsed embeddings.

规模和方向对等高斯人的独立性禁止这种依赖性,并且与对等名词相悖.

blocks.en:
The optimal coefficients λ ρ \lambda_{\rho} and λ u ^ \lambda_{\hat{u}} of PolarReg-naive depend on the batch size b {b} , embedding dimension d d , and the structure in the data ( Sec. 2.4 ).
For instance, the angular penalty averages over b ⁡ ( b − 1 ) / 2 {b}({b}-1)/2 pairs and ignores the magnitudes of the embeddings, so its gradient with respect to an embedding falls with b {b} and as 1 / ‖ m i ‖ 1/\left\|m_{i}\right\| , while the gradient of the alignment term grows with the magnitudes.
One way to remove these dependencies is to precondition the gradient of each penalty with its inverse Hessian, as in a Gauss–Newton step.
Since both penalties here, are squared 2-Wasserstein distances, they are quadratic, and this Newton step is simple.
We write the result of this step as a target embedding u i v ∗ u_{i}^{v*} , and pull u i v u_{i}^{v} towards it with Ω PolarReg \Omega_{\text{PolarReg}} in Eq. 10 , a squared distance between embeddings.
This introduces step sizes η ρ \eta_{\rho} and η u ^ \eta_{\hat{u}} which do not change with the batch size, embedding dimension or magnitudes of the embeddings ( Proposition B.3 ). Figure B.3 illustrates the construction on a toy batch.

blocks.en:
Proposition B.3 compares Ω PolarReg \Omega_{\text{PolarReg}} in Eq. 10 with the magnitude and angular regularizers in Eqs. 4 and 5 .
To first order, Ω PolarReg \Omega_{\text{PolarReg}} pulls embeddings along gradients of the magnitude and angular regularizers, with coefficients set by the batch.
The gradient of Ω PolarReg \Omega_{\text{PolarReg}} is zero if and only if the gradients of both regularizers are zero.

blocks.en: C.1 Implementation of the independence regularizer in Eq. 7
blocks.zh: C.1 在Eq. 7实施独立规范化

blocks.en:
Section 2.2 enforces independence of magnitude and direction by penalizing MMD 2 \text{MMD}^{2} . Results with this enforcement are presented in the “PolarReg-naive + Independence” row of Tab. 1 .
In this section, we provide details on which views ℓ ⟂ \ell_{\perp} uses, why it does not backpropagate through the magnitudes and bandwidths, its coefficient λ ⟂ \lambda_{\perp} , and how we measure MMD 2 \text{MMD}^{2} in Tab. 1 .
blocks.zh:
第2.2节通过惩罚MMD 2\text{MMD}^{2}实现规模和方向的独立. 这种执行的结果载于Tab的“PolarReg-naive + Independence”一行。 1 (英语).
在本节中,我们详细介绍l\\ ell\ perp} 使用何种观点, 为何它不通过宽度和带宽进行后置, 其系数 \\\ lambda\\ perp} , 以及如何在 Tab. 1 中测量 MMD 2\ text{ MMD\ } 。

blocks.en:
In Eq. 7 , we average only over the global views of each image; there are 2 global views on ImageNet-100.
A constant magnitude makes MMD 2 \text{MMD}^{2} zero for any set of directions. Hence, a gradient of ℓ ⟂ \ell_{\perp} with respect to the magnitudes would lower it by collapsing all magnitudes to one value.
Therefore, for ℓ ⟂ \ell_{\perp} we do not backpropagate through the magnitudes ρ i v \rho_{i}^{v} . We also treat the bandwidths σ ρ \sigma_{\rho} and σ u ^ \sigma_{\hat{u}} as constants, so ℓ ⟂ \ell_{\perp} moves only the directions, through the kernel values L i ​ j v L_{ij}^{v} .
We set λ ⟂ \lambda_{\perp} , so that the gradient of λ ⟂ ​ ℓ ⟂ \lambda_{\perp}\ell_{\perp} with respect to the embeddings has a similar norm as the gradient of λ u ^ ​ ℓ u ^ \lambda_{\hat{u}}\ell_{\hat{u}} .
blocks.zh:
在Eq. 7中,我们平均只看到每个图像的全球观点;在ImageNet-100上有两个全球观点。
一个常数使 MMD 2\text{MMD}^{2} 对任何一组方向都是零 。 因此,在大小方面,梯度为l \\ ell\ perp} 将使它降低, 将所有大小都降到一个值。
因此,对于l \ ell\ perp} 我们不会通过 $ i v\rho\i\v 的分量 支持。 我们还将带宽 \\ sigma\\rho} 和 \ u\ sigma\ hat{ u} 作为常数, 因此, l\ \ ell\ perp} 仅移动方向, 通过内核值 L i j v L\ ij\v } 。
我们设定了\\ lambda\\ perp} , 使得 \ \ \ \ \ lambda\\ ell\ perp} 在嵌入式上的梯度具有类似 \ u 的梯度 u \ l u \ \ lambda\ { u \ *** *** 的 规范 。

blocks.en:
In Tab. 1 , we compute Eq. 7 on one view of 3000 validation images, with bandwidths σ ρ \sigma_{\rho} and σ u ^ \sigma_{\hat{u}} from a random subset of 2000 of them.
Raw values of MMD 2 \text{MMD}^{2} are not comparable across methods, since the bandwidths are set from the embeddings of each method.
We divide the result by its standard deviation over 200 shuffles of the magnitudes across images, which make magnitude and direction independent; this ratio is comparable across methods.
blocks.zh:
在 Tab. 1 中, 我们在3000 验证图像的一个视图上计算 Eq. 7, 其中带宽为 \\ sigma\\rho} 和 \ u\ sigma\\ hat{u} 从其中2000 个随机子集中计算 。
MMD 2\text{MMD}^{2} 的原始值并不是跨方法的可比较性, 因为带宽是由每种方法的嵌入设置的.
我们通过它的标准偏差来将结果分为200个图像之间的震级,使震级和方向独立;这一比率在方法上是可比较的。

blocks.en: C.2 The coefficients of PolarReg-naive can be tuned once and scaled to new settings
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 PolarReg-naive 的系数可以调节一次并缩放到新的设置

blocks.en:

blocks.en: C.3 Clipping each optimizer step is a simple way to stabilize training of PolarReg-naive and sliced objectives
blocks.zh: C.3 每个优化步骤是稳定极地注册和切片目标的训练的简单方法

blocks.en:
In some PolarReg-naive and SIGReg runs, training collapses. A collapse starts with an update of ordinary gradient norm that moves the embeddings far from their target distribution, and the regularizer amplifies the change in a few steps. Gradient clipping is a poor fix. Its threshold depends on the scale of the loss, which differs 30 times across our datasets.
A threshold set too low or high, slows training or collapses it.
blocks.zh:
在一些极地注册和SIGREG运行中,训练崩溃. 崩溃开始于普通梯度规范的更新使嵌入体远离其目标分布,而正则器会用几个步骤来放大变化. 渐渐剪取是劣修. 它的阈值取决于损失的大小,它与我们的数据集不同了30倍。
门槛设置太低或太高,会延缓训练或使其崩溃.

blocks.en:
Adam divides each coordinate of the gradient by a running estimate of its scale, making the step approximately scale independent.
The running estimate averages over about 1000 steps, so a sudden change, such as the start of a collapse, makes the step unusually large.
We therefore clip the Adam step instead of the gradient, like Adafactor [ 36 ] . We rescale the step Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta whenever it exceeds τ = 2 \tau=2 times the median μ t \mu_{t} of recent step sizes [ 35 ] , Δ ​ θ ← Δ ​ θ ⋅ min ⁡ ( 1 , τ ​ μ t ‖ Δ ​ θ ‖ ) . \Delta\theta\leftarrow\Delta\theta\cdot\min\left(1,\frac{\tau\,\mu_{t}}{\left\|\Delta\theta\right\|}\right). (26) For our experiments, in standard training, the 99th percentile of ‖ Δ ​ θ ‖ \left\|\Delta\theta\right\| is 1.3–1.5 times its median, against 4.5–33 times for the gradient norm. During a collapse, for PolarReg-naive or SIGReg, the step size ‖ Δ ​ θ ‖ \left\|\Delta\theta\right\| reaches 12–20 times its median.
Setting τ = 2 \tau=2 prevented every collapse we observed. The threshold needs no tuning. It prevents collapse on both Tiny-ImageNet-200 and the ImageNet-100, whose tuned gradient clips differ by a factor of 10.

运行中估计平均约有1000多步,因此突然的改变,如开始倒塌,使得这一步异常地大.
因此,我们剪接亚当步骤而不是梯度,就像导师 [36]. 我们调整了台阶,只要它超过最近台阶尺寸的相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差 (26) 对我们的实验来说,在标准训练中,九十九分之九的分数是梯度规范的1.3-1.5倍。 在倒塌期间,对于极地注册公司(PolarReg-naive)或SIGREG(SIGREG),步数大小为相差12-20倍。

blocks.en: C.4 Training details
blocks.zh: C.4 培训细节

blocks.en:
We pretrain ViT-B/16 and ViT-L/14 encoders with the recipe of VISReg [ 45 ] . We do not do any hyperparameter search.
Each batch holds 512 images, and we make 4 global views at 224 px and 6 local views at 96 px for each image. Every view is a random resized crop, with scale [ 0.3 , 1 ] [0.3,1] for global views and [ 0.05 , 0.3 ] [0.05,0.3] for local views. It is then color jittered with probability 0.8 (brightness 0.4, contrast 0.4, saturation 0.2, hue 0.1), converted to grayscale with probability 0.2, blurred with a Gaussian of standard deviation in [ 0.1 , 2 ] [0.1,2] px with probability 0.5, solarized with probability 0.2, and flipped horizontally with probability 0.5.
The encoder output is mapped to the embeddings u i v u_{i}^{v} of Eq. 1 by a projector, an MLP with two hidden layers of width 2048, batch normalization and GELU activations. It takes the concatenated CLS tokens of the last two blocks, and outputs d = 256 d=256 dimensions for ViT-B and d = 384 d=384 for ViT-L.
We use the AdamW optimizer at a peak learning rate of 9 × 10 − 4 9\times 10^{-4} for ViT-B/16 and 8 × 10 − 4 8\times 10^{-4} for ViT-L/14, with a linear warm-up over 5 epochs followed by a cosine decay to 1 / 1000 1/1000 of the peak learning rate.
PolarReg uses η u ^ = 2 \eta_{\hat{u}}=2 and η ρ = 3 \eta_{\rho}=3 .
The linear probes on ImageNet-1k follow VISReg [ 45 ] . Classifiers on the concatenated CLS tokens of last four blocks of the frozen encoder are trained for 100 epochs with batch size 256. We report accuracy on the 50,000 validation images.
In Tab. 2 , all rows except ours are from VISReg [ 45 , Table 5] .

For other datasets, we follow VISReg [ 45 ] .
The features are the concatenated CLS tokens of the last four blocks of the frozen encoder, computed on images resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 pixels without augmentation.
They are standardized with batch statistics (BatchNorm without learnable parameters). A linear classifier trains on them for 10 epochs with batch size 32 at 13 learning rates.
For ChestX-ray14, where an image can have several of the 14 findings, the classifier is trained with a binary cross-entropy loss, and we report the mean average precision at the learning rate with the best mean AUROC.
Aircraft, Stanford Cars, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Flowers-102, Food-101, Oxford-IIIT Pets and DTD use their standard train and test splits. ChestX-ray14, and RetinaMNIST and OrganAMNIST from MedMNIST+ at 224 pixels, use their official splits.

blocks.en: D.1 The embedding magnitude can be used to detect unusual images
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 嵌入量可用于检测异常图像

blocks.en:
The embedding magnitude provides a test for images not resembling the training data. This test does not need any calibration data.
For each image, we test the null hypothesis that its magnitude is a draw from χ d \chi_{d} , with a one-sided test on the lower tail. The test rejects the null hypothesis, when its p-value is below α \alpha .
We choose only the lower tail because we expect unusual images to have larger view disagreement in their embeddings, and such images will attain smaller magnitudes ( Proposition B.2 ).
blocks.zh:
嵌入等分量为无法与训练数据相仿的图像提供了测试. 此测试不需要任何校正数据 。
对于每个图像,我们测试一个空假说,即其大小是取自于 \ d\chi_{d}的图,在下尾端进行一面测试. 当p值低于α-α时,测试会拒绝无效假说.
我们只选择下尾部,因为我们期望不寻常的图像在嵌入上会有更大的视野分歧,而这种图像会得到更小的分量(Proposition B.2.

blocks.en:
We apply this test to the ViT-B encoder trained with PolarReg on ImageNet-1k for 400 epochs, with d = 256 d=256 .
We term the 50,000 ImageNet-1k validation images as “in-domain”. The “out-of-domain” images are 5000 of ImageNet-1k validation images with different levels of corruptions, and images from datasets of other domains.
For each out-of-domain set, we report the area under the curve of the fraction of out-of-domain images the test rejects against the fraction of in-domain images it rejects, as α \alpha goes from 0 to 1. This area is simply the AUROC; 0.5 means the test detects out-of-domain images no better than chance, and 1 means some suitable α \alpha detects all of them without flagging any in-domain image.
blocks.zh:
我们把这个测试应用于在ImageNet-1k上经过极地Reg训练的ViT-B编码器,用于400个纪元,d=256 d=256.
我们把5万个ImageNet-1k验证图像称为“域内”。 “域外”图像是5,000个具有不同程度腐败的ImageNet-1k验证图像,以及来自其他域数据集的图像。
对于每个域外设定,我们报告域外图像分数曲线下的区域,测试拒绝的域内图像分数,因为α\α从0到1. 这个区域只是AUROC;0.5表示测试检测出域外图像并不比偶然更好,而1表示一些合适的α-α检测出所有图像而不标出域内图像.

blocks.en:
For corruptions in Tab. D.1 , blur convolves the image with a Gaussian of standard deviation σ \sigma pixels. A contrast change maps each pixel value x ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] x\in[0,1] to 0.5 + c ⁡ ( x − 0.5 ) 0.5+c\,(x-0.5) , for some contrast c c . Block averaging replaces each f × f f\times f block of pixels with its mean.
The test detects significant corruptions to the ImageNet-1k validation images.
It detects images averaged over 8 × 8 8\times 8 blocks with an AUROC of 0.99.
Minor corruptions are not detected.
Blur with σ = 1 \sigma=1 pixel and halved contrast are detected with an AUROC of 0.50.
This is perhaps because the encoder is trained to be invariant to such augmentations.
Images from datasets of other domains are detected with high AUROC.

blocks.en: D.2 The angular regularizer ℓ u ^ \ell_{\hat{u}} , in Eq. 5 , detects duplicated images in a batch
blocks.zh: D.2 联合国 在 Eq. 5 中, 角正则器 l u ^\ ell\ hat{u} 在批次中检测到重复图像

blocks.en:
Large image datasets, whether crawled from the web or recorded in the real world for robotics, contain many near-duplicate images. For instance, DINOv2 [ 32 ] removed about 200 million of its 1.3 billion crawled images as near-duplicates.
We test whether the angular regularizer and SIGReg flag duplicates, on synthetic batches and on trained encoders.
We compute each criterion on 1000 control batches of 256 samples of N ​ ( 0 , I d × d ) \text{N}(0,I_{d\times d}) , and use the 95th percentile of these values as its threshold. A duplicated batch is a control batch in which the directions of p p samples are replaced by the directions of p p others; p p pairs share a direction. We repeat this 5 times with fresh samples and report how many times the criterion exceeds its threshold.
Even with p = 1 p=1 , the angular regularizer is 6.2 times its mean on control batches at d = 64 d=64 , and exceeds its threshold in all 5 repeats.
SIGReg with 4096 slices stays within 8% of its mean up to 13 pairs, and exceeds its threshold in all constructions only at 32 pairs, a quarter of the batch.
Its values follow 1 + 2 ​ p / b 1+2p/{b} expectation derived in B.2 within 6%.
blocks.zh:
大型图像数据集,无论是从网络上爬出还是记录在真实世界中用于机器人,都包含许多相近复制的图像. 例如,DINOv2[32]将13亿个被爬取的图像中约2亿块作为近似复制.
我们测试角正则剂和SIGREG旗是否重复,在合成分批和经过训练的编码器上重复.
我们计算每1000个控制批次的256个N (0, I d × d)\text{N} (0, I_{d\times d) 样本的每个标准,并以这些值的95%作为阈值。 重复的批次是控制批次,其中p样本的方向被p其他对象的方向所取代;p对子共享一个方向. 我们用新鲜样品重复了5次,并报告标准超过门槛的几倍。
即使用p=1 p=1,角常态剂在d=64 d=64 时是控制批次上平均值的6.2倍,在所有5个重复中都超过了它的阈值.
含4096片的SIGREG停留在它的平均值的8%以内可达13对,在所有构造中只超过它的阈值为32对,是该批量的四分之一.
其数值在6%以内跟随1+2 p /b 1+2p/{b}从B.2得出的预期值。

For a similar deviation with 10% duplication, it only needs one duplicated batch.
SIGReg needs 22 batches to reach three standard deviations at 10%, and never reaches it at 5% or below.

blocks.en: D.4 PolarReg training generalizes to other modalities
blocks.zh: D.4 将极地区域培训推广到其他模式

blocks.en:
Figure D.1 : PolarReg featurizes depth images with the same objective as RGB images. (a) Example RGB and depth images from TartanAir. (b) Scene classification accuracy of linear classifiers on frozen features.
Depth trails RGB on daytime data, but stays accurate at night, when RGB fails.
An orthogonal map, fitted on unlabeled RGB and depth image pairs, aligns depth features with RGB features. Then, the RGB classifier is almost as accurate on depth images as the depth classifier, without any ground truth labels for depth.
blocks.zh:
图D.1:极地Reg以与RGB图像目标相同的深度图像为特色. (a) 来自TartanAir的示例RGB和深度图像。 (b) 关于被冻结特征的线性分类器的场景分类精度。
深度在白天数据上跟踪到RGB,但在夜间,当RGB失败时保持准确.
以无标签的RGB和深度图像对接而成的正向图,将深度特征与RGB特征相协调. 然后,RGB分类器在深度图像上几乎和深度分类器一样准确,没有为深度设置任何地面真实标签.

blocks.en:
To show that PolarReg can be applied to other data modalities, we train an encoder on depth images with the same objective and hyperparameters as on RGB images.
We use the RGB and depth images of the easy trajectories (“Data_easy”) of TartanAir v2 [ 33 ] , in 18 scenes, at 64 × 64 64\times 64 pixels.
We train on 126 trajectories and test on 30.
We never train and test on the same trajectory, repeated at different times of day and seasons, since these render the sensors at same viewpoints.
Five of these 18 scenes also have nighttime data. We train on the 38,487 daytime frames, and test on 5533 daytime and 1319 nighttime frames. Figure 1(a) shows some examples.
We train one ViT-S/8 encoder per modality from scratch for 100 epochs with PolarReg, η u ^ = 2 \eta_{\hat{u}}=2 and η ρ = 3 \eta_{\rho}=3 , as in every other experiment.
We take logarithm of distance as input for the depth encoder.
A linear classifier on frozen features predicts the scene where the RGB or depth image is captured from. Therefore, there are 18 classes to predict from.
blocks.zh:
为了表明PolarReg可以应用于其他数据模式,我们用与RGB图像相同的目标和超参数在深度图像上训练一个编码器.
我们使用TartanAir v2 [33]的简单轨迹的RGB和深度图像,在18个场景中,在64×64 64\times 64像素.
我们在126个轨道上训练,30个测试。
我们从不在同一轨迹上进行训练和试验,这些轨迹在不同的日子和季节反复出现,因为这些现象使传感器处于相同的角度。
这18个场景中有5个也有夜间数据. 我们按38 487个日间时间框架进行训练,并在5533个日间时间和1319个夜间时间框架进行测试。 图1(a)显示了一些例子。
我们从零开始为100个带极地列克的时代训练一个Vit-S/8编码器, 和所有其他实验一样, u = 2\eta_{\hat{u}}=2和 ρ = 3\eta_{\rho}=3。
我们把距离对数作为深度编码器的输入.
被冻结特征上的线性分解器预测了从中捕获RGB或深度图像的场景. 因此,有18个课程需要预测。

blocks.en:
Its classifier is 79.3% accurate on daytime frames, against 95.9% for RGB.
At night, the RGB classifier, trained only on daytime images, falls to 30.3%, while depth stays at 71.6%. Of course, this is expected given the depth sensor is invariant to lighting in TartanAir.
blocks.zh:
其分类器在日间时间框架上准确度为79.3%,而RGB为95.9%.
在夜间,仅接受日间图像训练的RGB分类器会降至30.3%,而深度则会保持在71.6%. 当然,鉴于深层传感器对TartanAir的照明不具有多样性,预计会出现这种情况。

blocks.en:
We fit an orthogonal map from depth features to RGB features, trained independently as described above.
We use only 8192 paired daytime frames to learn this map on the frozen features, standardized along each feature dimension.
The frozen RGB classifier is applied to the transformed depth features, achieving an accuracy of 75.1% on daytime and 68.5% on nighttime depth images.
Since the RGB and depth encoders are trained separately, nothing aligns their features, and transfer fails without the map.
So even without any ground truth labels for one modality, we can classify its data with a classifier trained for another modality, using only a few unlabeled pairs.
blocks.zh:
我们把一个从深度特征到RGB特征的正交地圖相接而来,如上所描述的独立训练.
我们只用8192个对齐的日间帧来学习这幅被冻结的地貌图,在每个地貌维度上标准化.
被冻结的RGB分级器被应用于变相深度特征,日间精度达到75.1%,夜间深度图像为68.5%.
由于RGB和深度编码器是分别训练的,所以没有任何东西会校正它们的特性,没有地图的传输失败.
因此,即使没有一种模式的地面真象标签, 我们可以用一种为另一种模式训练的分类器来分类它的数据, 只使用少数没有标记的对。

blocks.en:
A full multimodal training needs little beyond PolarReg.
With many paired sensor data, one could apply PolarReg to the joint features of both modalities directly, essentially treating them as a single modality.
We leave this, and sensors such as LiDAR, event cameras and radar, to future work.
blocks.zh:
完全的多模式培训仅需要极地区域。
有许多对子传感器数据,可以应用 与两种模式的共同特征直接对应,基本上将其视为一种单一模式。
我们把这个和LiDAR,事件相机和雷达等传感器留给未来工作.

blocks.en: D.5 PolarReg generalizes across domains, tasks and dataset scales
blocks.zh: D.5 跨域、任务和数据集尺度的平面化

blocks.en:
We probe frozen features of encoders pretrained on ImageNet-1k on six datasets from other domains, and on semantic segmentation of ADE20K. The results are presented in Tab. D.4 .
The out-of-domain datasets contain textures (DTD), galaxies (Galaxy10), aerial scenes (AID), chest X-rays (ChestX-ray14), retina images (RetinaMNIST) and abdominal CT (OrganAMNIST).
The classifiers are trained as in Sec. C.4 . For ChestX-ray14, where an image can have several of the 14 findings, we report mean average precision (mAP).
The segmentation head is a linear layer on frozen patch features.
For these tasks, PolarReg features perform similar to most other SSL methods, including the sliced objectives.

我们探测了在ImageNet-1k上预先训练的编码器在从其他域取出六个数据集上的被冻结特性,以及ADE20K的语义分解. 调查结果见Tab。 D.4. 国家

分块头是被冻结的补丁特征上的一个线性地层.
对于这些任务,PolarReg特性的性能与大多数其它SSL方法相类似,包括切出的目标.

blocks.en: D.6 PolarReg is more memory and compute efficient than sliced objectives
blocks.zh: D.6 PolarReg比切片目标更能存储和计算效率

blocks.en:
In Tab. D.6 , we time one forward and backward pass of each objective, on Gaussian embeddings of b {b} images with 10 views each and d = 256 d=256 , as in our ImageNet-1k runs.
SIGReg and VISReg use 4096 slices. We report the median of 10,000 calls.
PolarReg is overhead-bound. It is bound by GPU kernel launch overhead, not by the size of the intermediate tensors.
The sliced objectives are memory-bound.
They are bound by large tensor read-write operations that grow linearly with b {b} .
They project every embedding on 4096 slices. SIGReg also approximates the integral in Eq. 1 by evaluating the empirical characteristic function of each projection at several values of t t .
Reading and writing these numbers takes time proportional to b {b} .
PolarReg works with the b ​ v {b}{v} magnitudes and the inner products between the b {b} mean directions.
At these batch sizes, each of its kernels runs faster than PyTorch can launch it, so its time does not grow with b {b} .
Its backward pass is one elementwise operation, since no gradient flows through the targets.
blocks.zh:
在 Tab. D.6 中,我们给每个目标一个前向和后向的通过时间,在高斯嵌入的b {b}图像上,每个图像有10个视图,而d = 256 d = 256,就像我们的ImageNet-1k运行中一样.
SIGREG和VISReg使用4096个切片. 我们报告的中位数是一万个电话
PolarReg是高空行驶 它被GPU内核发射机顶部所约束,而不是由中间收发器的大小所约束.
片面的目标有内存。
它们被用 b {b} 线性地增长的大型 lamor 读写操作所束缚 。
它们投射出4096个植入物 SIGREG还通过以 t t 的数个值评价每个预测的经验性特征功能,来估算Eq. 1中的组成部分。
读取和写这些数字需要时间与 b {b} 成正比 。

在这些批量大小上,其每个内核运行速度都快于PyTorch可以发射,因此其时间不会随着b {b}而增长.
